scriptData.label: @effect.name

description.label: Description
description.value:
Your opponent aims low, sinking his weapon into the bony iliac crest high on your hip. Despite a nasty crunch your pelvis is only lightly chipped, your mobility unimpaired.

Effects: Gain @Condition[Bleeding] (1). Unless you pass an Average (+20) Endurance Test you are also @Condition[Stunned] (1), except you’ll not suffer any @Condition[Fatigued] Condition to replace it once removed. An Impressive Failure (-4 SL or more) will also leave you @Condition[Prone].
